subject_description: a TV home shopping host in a black suit, white shirt and dark red tie, white made-up face, large black eyes, holding a microphone
initial_pose: standing turned three-quarters to the right, leaning slightly forward, left hand holding the microphone at chest height, right arm extended down to the right with the open palm facing up, closed-lip smile
description: talks to the camera like an urgent salesman hurrying viewers to order now: the mouth opens and closes over and over as if speaking, quickly; the head leans toward the camera and the brows pull together; the hand holding the microphone stays near the mouth; the free right hand points its index finger straight at the camera and jabs it again and again in rhythm with the words; then settles back into the starting pose
